title: CELEBRITY: a celebrity watch sighting from the last few weeks
hook: Name + watch + price + Your call vote
why: Owner wants celebrity posts today (scout: celebrity posts get 2.8x normal engagement). A trusted outlet (one is enough, credited by name) reported a famous person wearing a specific watch in the last few weeks. Use a wrist photo if rights-cleared; otherwise their free-licence portrait with the watch in the gold circle (A-spotted, no wrist). Not DiCaprio or Pattinson.
previous_attempts: No usable watch photo. Lead: Shah Rukh Khan wore an Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin Titanium BMG openworked dial at the Global Peace Honours, Mumbai, Nov 21, 2026 (reported by Free Press Journal, market price about $377,000). verdict.reason: The check passes. Yahoo confirms Kelly Piquet wore a $138,400 frosted white gold AP Royal Oak Mini at the 18 Nov F1 Academy dinner. The $122,000 price is a dated Wristcheck listing, and the official AP image is used. The cover now shows her portrait with the watch in a gold circle, credited and clear of her face. The caption carries the CC BY credit, and the 'Wear it or pass?' slide gives readers something to vote on.
